description: This file defines a jQuery plugin for a multi-column navigator interface, including functions for list management, keyboard navigation, and dynamic data loading via AJAX.

classes.name: listColumn
classes.description: A class representing a list column with methods for navigation, selection, loading data, and UI state management.

methods.name: listColumn
methods.description: Constructor function for listColumn class, initializes list UI and data.

methods.name: buildColumn
methods.description: Builds a column in the navigator, sets up event handlers for navigation and data loading.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Constructs URL parameters based on selected item and navigates to the new URL.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Handles focus event on dropdown items.
